images.caption: Figure 1:Two views of cross-modal imputation.(a)Task: given a subset of observed modalities, synthesize the missing one.(b)Conventional view: modalities are encoded into disjoint latent manifolds (pixel space or per-modality VAE), so cross-modal generation is a long jump between them.(c)Our view: a frozen DINOv2 encoder maps every modality to a single shared hypersphere𝒮d−1\mathcal{S}^{d-1}, on which paired latents(zs,zt)(z_{s},z_{t})sit close together; imputation becomes short-range transport along the sphere.
